subject: words
title: Kn, wh and nk
about: The rest of CKLA Unit 6: kn says n (knee, knot), wh says w (whale, wheel) and n says ng before k (pink, thank). Unit 6 calls n a tricky spelling.
tip: For kn the k is quiet; for nk have him hum the ng sound before the k.
